full_prompt_en: A square cinematic fantasy landscape shows an armored traveler seated on a dark grassy ledge, looking toward a distant castle above a mist-filled valley. The person occupies the lower-left foreground in profile, face tilted upward toward the bright opening across the scene. Short dark hair and a rounded shoulder plate catch warm light; layered brown and brass clothing covers the torso and arms. One hand rests near the ground as the figure pauses at the edge of the view. From the center outward, steep wooded slopes descend into a pale blue-green basin covered with drifting fog. The far castle rises on a high rock near the upper middle, its narrow towers illuminated by a break in enormous peach and cream clouds. A winding pale route or watercourse traces through the valley toward the castle, linking the close figure to the distant goal. Dark trees and rocks frame the right edge, while small birds or debris specks punctuate the hazy air. The near foreground is detailed with moss, leaves, and rough stones; distant terrain is softer and increasingly luminous. Broad textured brushwork gives the clouds volume, and fine highlights describe armor edges and small spires. Warm light comes from the cloud opening ahead, catching the traveler's cheek and shoulder and leaving the foreground vegetation in deeper cool shade. The sky and mist provide the brightest values, with muted gold and rose balancing slate green and blue-gray. No text is visible. The overall composition is contemplative and expansive, using one still observer and a distant glowing destination to lead the eye through layered depth.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形电影感奇幻风景呈现一名披甲旅人坐在深色草坡边缘，望向雾谷上方的遥远城堡。人物以侧面占据左下前景，脸向上抬，朝画面远处的亮光缺口望去。短深发和圆形肩甲接住暖光；层叠棕色与黄铜色衣装覆盖躯干和手臂。一只手靠近地面，人物暂停在视野边缘。从中央向外，陡峭林坡下降进浅蓝绿盆地，里面漂着雾。远方城堡立于上方中部附近的高岩上，细塔被巨大桃色与奶油色云中的裂口照亮。一条蜿蜒浅色道路或水道穿过山谷通向城堡，把近处人物和远方目标连接起来。深色树木和岩石框住右缘，小鸟或碎屑般细点穿过雾气。近处前景有苔藓、叶片与粗石细节；远地更柔和，亮度逐渐上升。宽阔纹理笔触让云有体积，细亮边描出甲胄边缘和小塔。暖光从前方云隙而来，触及旅人的脸颊与肩，让前景植被留在较深冷影中。天空与薄雾是最亮区域，柔金和玫瑰色平衡石板绿与蓝灰。没有文字。整体构图沉思而辽阔，以一名静止观者和发亮的遥远目的地引导视线穿过层层纵深。
style_prompt_en: Cinematic fantasy painting builds immense depth through dark textured foreground, layered mist, and a distant warm luminous focus. Slate green, blue-gray, peach, cream, and muted gold shift gradually from cool near shadow to bright far atmosphere. Fine near detail gives way to broader softened shapes, while monumental cloud masses hold the upper frame. Backlight catches selected ridges and small highlights without revealing every recess. A single curved route through the space provides direction across the expansive composition. The result is contemplative, adventurous, and atmospheric.
style_prompt_zh: 电影感奇幻绘画通过深色纹理前景、层叠薄雾和远方暖亮焦点建立巨大纵深。石板绿、蓝灰、桃色、奶油与柔金从近处冷影渐渐转向远处明亮大气。精细近景细节逐步过渡成较宽柔形，宏大云团占据上部画框。逆光抓住部分棱脊和小亮点，却不照透每处凹陷。一条弯曲路径穿过空间，为辽阔构图提供方向。整体沉思、冒险感与氛围感并存。
theme_en: An armored traveler looking toward a distant castle above a misty valley
theme_zh: 一名披甲旅人望向雾谷上方的遥远城堡
name: Jordan Grimmer
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
